verdict: Yes. Neon Attack from Hyderabad pitched premium neon signs on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal, with strong revenue. LED neon signs are popular for cafés, weddings, offices and bedrooms, and each sign is made to order, so there's no dead stock.
angle: LED neon flex signs are cheaper, safer and lighter than old glass neon. Buyers order custom names, logos and quotes for cafés, events and homes. Speed of delivery and good design mock-ups decide who wins orders.

faq_extra.q: How much does it cost to start a neon sign business?
faq_extra.a: A small workshop with LED neon flex, acrylic cutting (often outsourced to a laser-cutting shop), power supplies and tools can start at ₹2–5 lakh. A laser cutter of your own adds ₹3–8 lakh.
